description: Code written to order: apps, sites, scripts and fixes.

deliveryDays.description: Days from the start of the deal to delivery.

stack.description: Languages, frameworks and tools the seller works in.

howDealsGo: The buyer pays into escrow at the start and releases when the code is delivered and runs as asked; a big job splits into several escrows, one per stage. A timer to the seller, set past the due date, pays finished work if the buyer goes quiet, and means a buyer who disagrees must settle before it runs out. Before paying, write down what done means and who owns the code.
